hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '^git (commit|push)'; then if git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^\.env$'; then echo '{"continue": false, "stopReason": "Blocked: .env is staged for commit. Remove it with: git reset HEAD .env"}'; exit 0; fi; fi; echo '{"continue": true}'
